strict_graph_invariant: Only real Agda dependencies create graph edges; conceptual similarity never creates a dependency.

emergent_endogenous_theorem.name: CanonicalEndogenousExactRNNLMVocabularyObservationClosureTheorem
emergent_endogenous_theorem.verification: Constructor and term are present on the Agda proof surface. Fresh Agda --safe/Nix-Dhall CI remains required before declaring repository verification green.

emergent_vocabulary_boundary_theorem.name: CanonicalEndogenousFiniteVocabularyRecurrentSequenceClosureCandidate
emergent_vocabulary_boundary_theorem.statement: The connected recurrent, conjugate, list-state, and observation components can generate arbitrarily long finite token sequences while preserving a per-step token codomain of exactly Fin 256. Recurrence and conjugacy enlarge the reachable sequence language across time; they do not enlarge the one-step vocabulary carrier.

cardinality_boundary.all_finite_lengths: countably many finite sequences over the fixed finite alphabet
cardinality_boundary.important_distinction: The number of representable sequences can grow without bound even though the vocabulary remains fixed at 256.

emergent_vocabulary_boundary_theorem.non_expansion_rule: No recurrent state component, conjugacy, prefix monoid action, list encoding, or observation transport is allowed to be interpreted as a vocabulary expansion unless an actual decoder with a larger codomain is introduced and proved.
promotion_gate: Add an actual Agda record consuming the listed dependencies.
Prove the per-step codomain remains CanonicalToken.
Prove the finite-sequence construction and conjugacy transport.
Discover the same path in theorem_graph_search and theorem_monolith_egraph_sync.
Do not classify it as a strict function-class separation theorem.

foundational_zero_dependency_policy.rule: Do not fabricate edges for problem specifications or foundational records.
foundational_zero_dependency_policy.handling: They remain proof-surface/problem records until a real composed theorem consumes their semantics.

vocabulary.latin_condition: A Latin tokenizer is representable exactly when its token inventory is no larger than 256; this is not an unrestricted Unicode claim.
vocabulary.state_vs_vocabulary: CanonicalFullLearnerState contains unbounded Nat components and finite Int8/action components, but these state resources do not change the CanonicalToken output carrier.

nat_successor.finite_sequence_boundary: requires an explicit finite-position boundary or terminal convention

sequence_container.Data.List: appropriate for variable-length finite sequences and concatenation
sequence_container.Vec_Fin: cleaner for fixed-length indexed sequence proofs

inductive_bias: causal recurrent sequential composition; not intrinsically hierarchical, convolutional, or symmetric
future_admission: Every future theorem must enter through a real composed parent or remain foundational outside strict separation.
